title: All in a Single Night
description: Find the shortest and longest route visiting every location exactly once.
writeup:
## Approach

This is the classic Travelling Salesman Problem (TSP). With only 8 locations in the puzzle input, brute-forcing all permutations (8! = 40,320 routes) is perfectly feasible.

## Part 1

Parse each distance entry into a symmetric adjacency map, then evaluate every permutation of cities and return the minimum total distance.

## Part 2

Same approach, but return the maximum total distance instead. Since we already computed all route distances for Part 1, this is essentially free.
